final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(unit_price AS FLOAT)) as overall_baseline FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(CAST(unit_price AS FLOAT)) as type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), above_baseline AS (SELECT ta.*, b.overall_baseline FROM type_avgs ta, baseline b WHERE ta.type_avg > b.overall_baseline), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as mean_val FROM above_baseline), final_set AS (SELECT ab.*, b.overall_baseline, km.mean_val FROM above_baseline ab, baseline b, kept_mean km WHERE ab.type_avg > km.mean_val) SELECT AVG(type_avg) as avg_type_price, AVG(type_avg - overall_baseline) as avg_above_baseline, AVG(type_avg - mean_val) as avg_above_mean FROM final_set
